description:
2023 Toyota Camry XLE: Premium Comfort Meets Everyday Efficiency
The 2023 Toyota Camry XLE delivers a masterful balance of sophisticated design, quiet cabin luxury, and remarkable fuel economy. Dressed in an elegant Celestial Silver Metallic finish, this executive sedan offers impressive ratings of up to 38 MPG highway, making it an ideal choice for drivers navigating daily routines in Mesa. Step inside the refined Ash interior featuring leather front seat upholstery, where thoughtful amenities elevate every leg of your trip. If you are searching for a dependable, high-quality midsize sedan, we invite you to
explore our selection of pre-owned cars
today.
Refined Performance and Highway Efficiency
Under the hood, the 2023 Toyota Camry XLE is powered by a smooth 2.5L I-4 engine with 203HP. Pairing dual overhead cams and VVT-iE/VVT-i variable valve control with an 8-speed automatic transmission (8-Speed Direct Shift ECT-i Automatic), this sedan seamlessly balances responsive acceleration with exceptional efficiency. Front Wheel Drive technology ensures predictable, composed handling across daily drives.
Engineered with gas-pressurized shock absorbers, an independent strut front suspension, and a multi-link rear suspension, the Camry delivers a remarkably smooth ride quality. Features like an auto stop-start engine system, a 2.80 axle ratio, a single stainless steel exhaust with a chrome tailpipe finisher, and 18-inch machined alloy wheels with painted accents enhance both capability and curb appeal. A 15.8-gallon fuel tank paired with EPA-estimated ratings of 27 MPG city and 38 MPG highway allows for long stretches between fill-ups.
Advanced Technology and Driver Assistance
The interior of the 2023 Toyota Camry XLE is loaded with modern tech designed to keep you connected and confident. Highlights include the Navigation Package, featuring a 9-inch primary touchscreen display with integrated Dynamic Navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and a premium 9-speaker JBL audio system with a subwoofer and amplifier. Drivers benefit from a 7.0-inch digital gauge cluster display and a 10-inch Color Head-Up Display that projects vital driving data straight onto the windshield.
For peace of mind, this vehicle comes equipped with Toyota Safety Sense 2.5+ and the comprehensive Driver Assist Package. You will enjoy Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Blind Spot Monitor, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, and Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking. Parking maneuvers are simplified using the Panoramic View Monitor with a Bird's Eye View Camera. Qi-compatible wireless smart device charging and a HomeLink garage door opener add daily convenience. Before coming in for a test drive, you can easily
apply for financing online
to streamline your purchase.
Key Highlights
Experience the standout features that make this sedan exceptional:
2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine
- Delivers 203 horsepower while achieving up to 38 MPG on the highway.
Driver Assist Package
- Outfitted with a 10-inch Color Head-Up Display, Panoramic View Monitor, and Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking.
Navigation Package
- Features a 9-inch touchscreen, Dynamic Navigation, and a 9-speaker JBL premium sound system.
Multi-Stage Ventilated and Heated Front Seats
- Wrapped in Ash leather upholstery for customized all-season comfort.
Panoramic Glass Roof
- Power tilt and sliding moonroof with a one-touch power sunshade.
Toyota Safety Sense 2.5+
- Includes Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control and Lane Tracing Assist.
Qi-Compatible Wireless Charging
- Powers up your compatible smartphone without messy cord clutter.
18-Inch Machined Alloy Wheels
- Complemented by a striking Celestial Silver Metallic exterior finish.

Safety and Security
Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicles private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. The Toyota RAV4 turns 30 this year, and it is still obvious why the compact crossover regularly ranks as the best-selling non-pickup in the U.S. The RAV4s focus is on getting every job done without a fuss. It is practical, fuel-efficient, and rugged-looking. Toyota also includes a host of driver-assistance tech and desirable infotainment features as standard, two more ways the RAV4 continues to be a challenge for rivals to overcome. The compact crossover is solid and stable when cruising the interstate and competent when pitched into a twisty section of road. The RAV4s interior prioritizes occupant comfort and cubby storage. The RAV4's rear seats are easy to stow, and they fold to a nearly flat position, opening up the cabin for cargo. We fit 10 of our carry-on suitcases behind the rear seat and 22 with it folded. The RAV4 is a pleasant SUV that rides smoothly, has a roomy interior that's easy to live with, and offers plenty of utility. It brakes and handles in a confident way, and it's fuel-efficient. How comfortable is the RAV4? The RAV4's suspension is tuned to strike a good balance between control and softness. The body doesn't bound or float when you drive over bumps, and small to moderate impacts are absorbed without much drama. As for the front seats, they are nicely sculpted and padded appropriately. How's the interior? The driving position, roominess, and ease of getting in and out are all good. How's the tech? The RAV4's interface has a mix of touchscreen and fixed buttons, and both are easy to learn without consulting the owner's manual. Hows the storage? The RAV4's cargo hold is nearly the biggest in its class. You get 37.5 cubic feet with the rear seats up and 69.8 cubic feet with them stowed. The RAV4 is also easy to load thanks to a low cargo floor. Up front, the cabin has numerous shelves and bins to handle assorted road-trip paraphernalia. Parents with young kids will appreciate the RAV4. It's easy to locate and connect safety seats to the lower car seat anchors. Likewise, tethering to the three upper anchors is straightforward. Forward-facing seats and boosters fit readily.

Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it.  Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.  Now, with Distance pacing cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead.   Distance pacing cruise control; your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.

Safety and Security
Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Thats when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians dont always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldnt by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes thats both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicles infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what youre looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicles private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Automatic full-time 4-wheel drive - All four safety. In wet or slippery conditions the more grip your wheels can maintain, the safer your drive. Automatic full-time 4-wheel drive automatically delivers power to all four wheels when it is needed, providing excellent traction in adverse weather and road conditions. Get a firm grip on the road and added peace of mind in poor weather conditions with Automatic full-time 4-wheel drive.
All wheel drive - all weather drive. In wet or slippery conditions the more grip your wheels can maintain, the safer your drive.  All wheel drive powers both the front and rear axles, allowing the center differential to redirect power to the wheels with greater traction when slip is detected.  So get a firm grip on the road, better acceleration and added peace of mind in poor weather conditions with all-wheel drive.
Safety and Security
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.

Safety and Security
Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.  Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

 Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. The 2020 Escape also reflects Fords push toward a more advanced driver-assistance package, with standard adaptive cruise control-related hardware listed alongside lane-centering assistance features in the broader model family, even as this specific VINs decoded equipment focuses on the SELs core safety and convenience set. It was assembled in the United States, uses a left-hand-drive layout, seats five across two rows, and carries the kind of compact-SUV packaging that made the Escape one of the most closely watched redesigns in Fords lineup for 2020. Combining a spacious crew cab with a longer 157-inch wheelbase, this truck offers the perfect balance of passenger room and cargo utility, making it a standout option for those who demand efficiency and dependability on every job site.Under the hood, this 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 is powered by a capable 4.3L 6-cylinder engine, delivering the proven performance and torque needed for daily hauling and towing. The rear-wheel-drive (2WD) configuration ensures optimal efficiency and smooth handling on paved roads and highways. Built on a robust chassis, this Work Truck configuration provides a longer bed length that maximizes cargo-carrying capacity, ensuring you have ample space for tools, equipment, or materials while maintaining excellent ride stability.Inside, the cabin is outfitted with a practical and durable Jet Black interior designed to withstand the wear and tear of a busy workday. This vehicle comes well-equipped with functional upgrades, including the WT Convenience Package and the WT Fleet Convenience Package for added driver comfort and operational ease. Safety is prioritized on the road with the WT Safety Package, while cargo security and weather protection are enhanced by the inclusion of an LPO hard-folding tonneau cover and an LPO tri-fold soft tonneau cover. For buyers seeking a highly functional, secure, and modern commercial vehicle, this configured 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Work Truck represents the ultimate value.

Convenience features like remote start, keyless entry, heated power mirrors, EZ Lift tailgate, and chrome assist steps make every drive easier. With 4X4 capability, 18" aluminum wheels, and a rugged suspension, this Silverado is ready for work or play. Safety features include a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and the emergency communication capabilities of OnStar and Chevrolet connected services. The backup camera provides visibility when reversing, adding an extra layer of confidence during parking and low-speed maneuvers.  The 1.5L DOHC engine with CVT transmission and front-wheel drive delivers efficient fuel economy, achieving 29 MPG in the city and 36 MPG on the highway, making this sedan an economical choice for daily commuting and longer drives. description: This 2017 Chevrolet Tahoe LS in black represents a capable and spacious full-size SUV built to handle both daily driving and adventure.  - 4WD with 2-Speed Active Transfer Case - Max Trailering Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller - Premium Smooth Ride Suspension Package - 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 Engine - SiriusXM Satellite Radio with Chevrolet MyLink - Remote Vehicle Start - Rear Park Assist with Audible Warning - OnStar Basic Plan for 5 Years - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration - Three Rows of Seating with 60/40 Split-Folding Second and Third Row Benches - Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control - Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel - Black Roof Rack Cross Rails - 18-Inch Aluminum Wheels  The Tahoe LS delivers practical three-row seating that accommodates up to eight passengers, making it ideal for families or those who regularly transport groups. The flexible seating configuration, featuring 60/40 split-folding second and third row benches, allows you to customize the interior space between passengers and cargo to suit your needs on any given day.  Under the hood sits a proven 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, delivering solid performance and returning 16 mpg city and 22 mpg highway. The 4WD system with 2-speed active transfer case provides confidence on various road conditions, while the Max Trailering Packagecomplete with a 3.42 rear axle ratio, integrated trailer brake controller, and suspension upgradesequips this Tahoe to handle towing responsibilities.  The interior reflects thoughtful design for daily convenience. Dual zone automatic temperature control keeps passengers comfortable regardless of their seating position. Chevrolet MyLink with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected to navigation and entertainment, while the SiriusXM satellite radio adds variety to your drive. Remote vehicle start, rear park assist, and OnStar Basic Plan for five years add practical benefits to your ownership experience.  Safety and visibility are prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system, 4-wheel antilock disc brakes with brake assist, electronic stability control, and a rear parking camera. Heated mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and LED reading lights throughout the cabin contribute to comfort and visibility in various conditions.  This Tahoe LS is ready to serve as your dependable companion for work, family outings, or weekend getaways. We invite you to come see it in our showroom and experience the space and capability this vehicle offers firsthand.

Safety and Security
Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.  Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
